description:
## Summary

The work-unit lifecycle — open, read (including the comment log), progress comments, claim, state transitions — is realized on native Radicle issues, replacing the connector operations that decompose and define prose invoke today (`create-work-unit`, `read-work-unit`, `claim-work-unit`, `record-progress`). Groundwork's planning home becomes the Radicle issue store itself.

Part of: #538.

## Scope

- `protocols/decompose` (the deliver-work-unit procedure and creation/refinement prose)
- `protocols/define` (entry reading; the claim seam in its workspace references)
- Issue-lifecycle mechanics (manifest-registered)
- Tests

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] decompose opens tracker-backed work-units as native Radicle issues carrying title, description, and labels, and its delivery procedure carries the Radicle handle into the delivered artifact — creation verified by durable read-back.
- [ ] Work-unit reading includes the comment log; progress is recorded as issue comments, satisfying the resumption obligation's surface (work-unit-craft).
- [ ] Claiming is reflected as DID assignment, or by the documented comment convention if the spike found non-delegate assignment unavailable — exactly one documented claim mechanic, grounded in the spike's finding.
- [ ] Issue states (open/closed/solved) are the state vocabulary the protocol prose uses; every issue mutation class verifies by read-back per the verification mechanics.
- [ ] No connector operation is invoked from decompose or define prose; all referenced mechanics are manifest-registered; tests cover the lifecycle including failure paths.
- [ ] The decompose and define protocol renderings describe the Radicle lifecycle where implementing agents first meet it.

## Contract inputs

- **Behavior:** a work-unit opened by decompose is readable back (title, body, labels, comments) from the durable issue state; a refused creation fails the delivery.
- **Documentation:** the deliver-work-unit procedure is the first-contact surface for every future decompose run — it must be complete standalone.
- **Code quality:** sovereignty — protocol prose passes outcomes; mechanics carry the how (`~/.groundwork/principles/`).

## Dependencies

Depends on: #598, #600.
